description: tests/test_refs.py is the behavioral test for the 'tether refs PATH' command; tether/storage.py find_by_path is its matching core, returning tethers whose a.path OR b.path exactly equals the queried path. The tests pin that matching (a-side, b-side, multi-match, missing-on-disk still resolves), severity ordering of the result, and corrupt-record handling. Changes to find_by_path path-matching semantics must be reflected here.
